description: Every daily embedding execution plan should write model profiles and route work to a default local profile unless an approved pricing and trust-boundary override exists.
Object embedding rows should be split into retryable batches with item counts, estimated tokens, subject ids, embedding ids, text hashes, and content hashes.
Each embedding profile should report provider, model, runtime, dimensions, row count, estimated tokens, unit price when known, and estimated USD when pricing is available.
Vector readiness should be audited immediately after planning so missing, stored, mismatched, and orphan vectors are explicit before tenant-visible vector search.
Daily embedding execution planning should not call providers, write vectors, or connect to databases; worker execution is a separate approved action.
